Method of Attack: Disables Endpoint Detection & Response (EDR) software by dropping a vulnerable signed Windows driver (procexp.sys) to run with kernel privileges, continuously probing and disabling security processes and services to prevent their restart, enabling deployment of backdoors and ransomware in Bring Your Own Vulnerable Driver (BYOVD) attacks
Escalates privileges by impersonating the TrustedInstaller Windows Modules Installer service to gain SYSTEM privileges
Impacted Systems: Windows systems running Microsoft's Process Explorer v16.32
Attack Vector: Dropping legitimate signed vulnerable drivers capable of kernel privilege execution on victim devices
Indicators of Compromise: Presence of vulnerable Windows driver procexp.sys alongside Process Explorer v16.32 driver
Date of Discovery: Mid-February 2023 (newest sample compilation timestamp and usage in attacks)
